overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（6 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（3 篇）、金融科技（1 篇）。方法上以数值模拟、回归分析为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、OpenAlex（3 篇）、SSRN（1 篇）。其中 1 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Tantangan Pemungutan PPN atas Transaksi E-Commerce dalam Sistem Perpajakan Digital Indonesia Terkini
papers.abstract: E-commerce transactions expand the digital consumption of goods and services, but they also complicate the collection of Value Added Tax (VAT). This study analyzes the challenges of VAT collection on e-commerce transactions through a normative juridical review of the VAT Law as amended by Law No. 7 of 2021 on the Harmonization of Tax Regulations, Government Regulation No. 44 of 2022, Minister of Finance Regulation No. 60/PMK.03/2022, and Director General of Taxes Regulation No. PER-12/PJ/2020, together with relevant scholarly literature. The analysis reveals three groups of problems. First, regulatory problems arise in determining the collecting party and in the treatment of the utilization of intangible taxable goods and/or taxable services from outside the customs area. Second, administrative problems appear in the limited identification, matching, and integration of cross-platform transaction data. Third, technical and compliance problems concern transactions outside formal platforms, the understanding of business actors, and data governance. Minister of Finance Regulation No. 60/PMK.03/2022 has provided a mechanism for appointing VAT collectors for trade through electronic systems (PMSE), yet its effectiveness still depends on certainty of guidelines, lawful data interoperability, and easily accessible compliance services. This study recommends strengthening responsive regulation, risk-based administrative integration, and the role of platforms as compliance facilitators while protecting personal data.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融科技】电子商务交易促进了商品和服务的数字化消费，但同时也使得增值税（VAT）的征收变得更加复杂。本研究通过规范法律分析，探讨了电子商务交易中增值税征收所面临的挑战。分析依据包括2021年第7号法律《税收法规协调法》、2022年第44号政府条例、2022年第60/PMK.03号财政部长条例以及2020年第PER-12/PJ号税务总局条例的修订内容，并参考了相关学术文献。研究发现存在三类主要问题：  

首先，监管方面的问题主要体现在确定增值税征收主体，以及如何处理来自海关区域外的无形应税商品和/或应税服务的征税问题上。  

其次，行政方面的问题体现在跨平台交易数据的识别、匹配和整合能力不足。  

最后，技术和合规性问题涉及非正式平台上的交易、相关商业主体的理解以及数据治理机制的缺失。  

2022年第60/PMK.03号财政部长条例为通过电子系统（PMSE）进行增值税征收提供了相关机制，但其有效性仍取决于相关指导方针的明确性、数据互操作性的保障以及便捷的合规服务。  

本研究建议加强适应性强的监管措施，推动基于风险的行政整合，并发挥平台在促进合规方面的作用，同时确保个人数据得到妥...。

papers.title: Pengaruh CAR, BOPO, dan Inflasi terhadap ROA pada PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. Periode 2021–2025
papers.abstract: The profitability of PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk., as proxied by Return on Assets, fluctuated during the post-merger period of 2021–2025, making it necessary to analyze the internal and external factors affecting it. This study aims to analyze the effect of the Capital Adequacy Ratio, Operating Expenses to Operating Income, and Inflation on Return on Assets at PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. for the 2021–2025 period. The study employs a quantitative method with an associative approach. The secondary data consist of the quarterly financial statements of PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. and inflation data published by Statistics Indonesia (Badan Pusat Statistik), comprising 20 observations from the first quarter of 2021 to the fourth quarter of 2025, selected using a purposive sampling technique. This study is limited to a single company, namely PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. The data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, classical assumption tests, multiple linear regression, the coefficient of determination, the t-test, and the F-test with the aid of IBM SPSS 25. The results show that the Capital Adequacy Ratio has a positive and significant effect on Return on Assets, whereas Operating Expenses to Operating Income has a negative and significant effect on Return on Assets. Inflation has a positive but insignificant effect on Return on Assets. Simultaneously, the three variables have a significant effect on Return on Assets. The study concludes that the profitability of PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. during the study period was influenced by capital adequacy and operational efficiency, while inflation did not show a significant effect.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】印度尼西亚伊斯兰银行（PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk.）的盈利能力，以资产回报率（Return on Assets）为指标，在2021年至2025年的合并后时期呈现出波动趋势，因此有必要分析影响其盈利能力的内部和外部因素。本研究旨在探讨资本充足率（Capital Adequacy Ratio）、营业费用与营业收入之比（Operating Expenses to Operating Income）以及通货膨胀（Inflation）对印度尼西亚伊斯兰银行2021年至2025年期间资产回报率的影响。研究采用定量分析方法，并运用关联分析（associative approach）进行数据解读。所使用的二手数据包括印度尼西亚伊斯兰银行的季度财务报表以及印度尼西亚中央统计局（Badan Pusat Statistik）发布的通货膨胀数据，样本覆盖2021年第一季度至2025年第四季度的20个观测值，数据采集采用目的性抽样（purposive sampling）技术。本研究仅针对印度尼西亚伊斯兰银行这一家公司展开。数据分析工具包括描述性统计方法、经典假设检验、多元线...。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: The CEO Overhang Effect
papers.abstract: <p>We document that CEOs reduce investment, increase net leverage, and expand net share repurchases over their tenure. To explain these patterns, we develop a dynamic model of a firm run by a sequence of CEOs. Each CEO has a finite tenure and chooses investment, financing, and payout to maximize her utility over wealth under a contract that combines a base salary with equity-based pay. The model identifies a new mechanism, the CEO overhang effect, which arises because the CEO's horizon is truncated and future CEOs are also granted equity. As a result, over her tenure a growing share of the returns to the firm's capital and of its costs of debt shifts from current shareholders, including the CEO, to future CEOs. The incumbent CEO therefore underinvests and levers up. She also increasingly repurchases shares, because a larger stake becomes more valuable to her as turnover approaches. Calibrating the model, we infer that the resulting agency cost amounts to 6% of shareholder value.</p>
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们发现，在任期间，首席执行官（CEO）往往会减少投资、增加净杠杆比率，并扩大股票回购规模。为了解释这些现象，我们构建了一个动态模型，该模型描述了由多位CEO轮流管理的公司运营情况。每位CEO的任期都是有限的，他们需要在合同约束下（合同包含基本工资和基于股权的薪酬）做出投资、融资和利润分配决策，以最大化自身财富效用。模型揭示了一种新的机制——即“CEO任期重叠效应”：由于CEO的任期是有限的，且未来的CEO也会获得股权，因此公司资本收益和债务成本中越来越多的部分会从现任股东（包括CEO本身）转移到未来的CEO手中。因此，现任CEO会减少投资、提高杠杆比率，并增加股票回购力度；随着任期临近尾声，她持有的股份价值上升，回购行为会更加频繁。通过模型校准，我们估算出由此产生的代理成本占股东价值的6%。。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Pragmatic Deeply Debiased ML
papers.abstract: Debiased machine learning (DML) combines a fitted outcome regression with weighted residuals to remove first-order regularization bias when estimating parameters such as average treatment effects, yet a second-order bias remains whenever regression and weighting errors align. For linear regression functionals, we target this second-order bias by training a strong learner to predict first-stage residuals from many covariates, yielding a one-dimensional (or low-dimensional) working model whose bias contribution is estimated on an independent sample. To complement this targeted search, we also analyze general kernel-based corrections, including covariate partitions and smoothers. We prove that deeply debiased ML is algebraically identical to ordinary DML evaluated with a post-hoc regression update that adjusts each scored observation using kernel-weighted residuals from the remaining evaluation observations. In our empirical and simulation studies, strong initial DML learners often leave the second-order correction small relative to sampling uncertainty, in which case the correction serves as a diagnostic check alongside sensitivity bounds for any remaining misspecification bias.
papers.summary_zh: 【行为金融】无偏机器学习（Debiased Machine Learning, DML）通过将拟合后的结果回归与加权残差相结合，来消除在估计参数（如平均处理效应）时产生的一阶正则化偏差；然而，当回归误差与加权误差同时存在时，仍会残留二阶偏差。对于线性回归函数，我们通过训练一个强大的学习模型来预测由多个协变量产生的第一阶段残差，从而得到一个一维（或低维）的工作模型，并在该模型上独立样本的基础上估计其偏差贡献。为了进一步完善这一方法，我们还分析了基于核函数的一般校正方法，包括协变量划分和平滑处理技术。我们证明了深度无偏机器学习在数学上与传统的DML是等价的——后者通过事后回归更新来实现偏差校正，即利用剩余评估样本的核加权残差来调整每个观测值。在我们的实证研究和模拟实验中，强大的初始DML模型通常能够将二阶偏差控制在采样不确定性的范围内；在这种情况下，这种校正不仅有助于诊断模型中的问题，还能为任何潜在的错误设定偏差提供敏感性评估依据。。研究方法：回归分析、数值模拟、机器学习。

papers.title: Worth the Wait? How Response Time and Streaming Shape Judgments of Generative AI Answers and Chatbot Engagement
papers.abstract: Answers from generative AI chatbots built on large language models (LLMs) now arrive at very different speeds: reasoning models deliberate before replying, while response caches can return a stored answer at once. Blind preference votes, which rank these models, are read as judgments of their text, and if delivery matters, faster answers are expected to gain. Research on the labor illusion and on how text appears on screen suggests instead that an answer which unfolds as it is written is credited over the same answer shown at once. We test these accounts with three sources of variation in natural use. First, compar:IA, a French government chatbot arena, answered repeated prompts, by a random draw, either with a fresh answer streamed as it was written or with a stored earlier answer from the same model, shown at once. Within the same prompt, a replay lowered an answer's chance of winning a decisive blind vote by 25.8 percentage points. The same stored text won 57% of its decisive votes when streamed and 29% when replayed, and voters called it less complete, more superficial and more often incorrect when replayed. Second, provider congestion slowed streamed answers. In 324,029 conversations, slower answers earned no detectable net credit in the vote, but a slower first exchange made visitors less likely to ask a follow-up question. Third, in 4,378,514 WildChat replies from everyday ChatGPT use, replies slowed by congestion made users less likely to continue. Delivery moved blind votes, in the direction opposite to the one the arena's designers expected, while waiting cost follow-up questions that a comparison between two answers cannot register when both are slow. The results bear on how AI services cache and stream answers, how they budget latency, and how preference leaderboards evaluate models.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】基于大规模语言模型（LLMs）的生成式AI聊天机器人的响应速度存在显著差异：推理型模型在回复前会进行深思熟虑，而响应缓存则能立即返回存储好的答案。通过盲选投票对这些模型进行排名时，人们实际上是在评估它们的文本质量；如果响应速度至关重要，那么更快的答案更有可能胜出。关于“劳动幻觉”（即人们误以为AI需要耗费大量时间进行处理）以及文本在屏幕上呈现方式的研究表明，用户更倾向于认可那些边生成边显示的答案，而非一次性完整呈现的答案。我们通过三种自然使用场景来验证这些观点。

首先，在法国政府的聊天机器人平台ComparIA中，系统会随机选择两种方式来回答重复的请求：一种是实时生成新答案并立即显示；另一种则是从同一模型中调用之前存储的答案并立即展示。在同一问题下，重复展示答案会使该答案在盲选投票中获胜的概率降低25.8%。同样的存储文本在实时生成时获得了57%的投票支持，而在重复展示时仅获得29%的支持率；此外，用户认为重复展示的答案不够完整、较为肤浅且错误率更高。

其次，服务提供商的响应延迟会影响到实时生成的答案的评分。在324,029次对话中，延迟生成的答案并未在投票中带来任何明显的优...。研究方法：大语言模型。

papers.title: Does Treating Addiction Rebuild Lives? Evidence from Buprenorphine
papers.abstract: Does treating addiction improve economic circumstances as well as health? Using two decades of Veterans Health Administration records on over 140,000 patients with opioid use disorder and consumer credit data, we exploit staggered facility-level buprenorphine adoption and quasi-random emergency physician assignment. A five-percentage-point increase in the share of clinicians with buprenorphine prescribing experience doubles overdose survivors’ long-term medication use and reduces two-year mortality by an estimated 3.7 percentage points. Instrumenting receipt yields a 22 percent credit score gain. At $300,000 per statistical life-year, estimated survival benefits alone exceed added medical costs within three years
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】治疗成瘾是否既能改善健康状况，又能提升经济状况？我们利用了退伍军人健康管理局二十年来关于14万多名阿片类药物使用障碍患者的记录以及消费者信用数据，分析了不同医疗机构逐步采用丁丙诺啡的情况，并结合了急诊医生的随机分配机制。当具有丁丙诺啡处方经验的临床医生比例增加5个百分点时，过量用药者的长期用药率翻了一番，两年内的死亡率降低了约3.7个百分点。此外，接受丁丙诺啡治疗的患者信用评分平均提升了22%。按每统计生命年30万美元的成本计算，仅生存收益在三年内就超过了额外的医疗支出。。

papers.title: Klasterisasi Karakteristik Pengguna E-Commerce Berdasarkan Profil Pengguna Menggunakan Algoritma K-Prototypes
papers.abstract: Accurate customer segmentation supports more personalized e-commerce marketing. However, the Recency, Frequency, Monetary (RFM) model focuses on transaction history and may not fully capture shopping motivation or the share of a consumer’s spending allocated to e-commerce (Share of Wallet/SoW). This study aims to cluster e-commerce users based on transaction profiles and consumer behavior using the K-Prototypes algorithm. Data were collected from 198 e-commerce users in Palembang, Indonesia. The clustering variables included RFM, SoW, shopping motivation, and product-category preferences, while age category was used for follow-up analysis. The Elbow Method and Silhouette Score supported a four-cluster solution. The resulting personas were High-Value Promo Hunters, Routine Pragmatic Shoppers, Passive Micro-Spenders, and Urgent Big-Ticket Buyers. The Chi-square test indicated a significant association between age category and persona, with Cramér’s V of 0.274. This suggests that age is associated with shopping patterns but does not fully determine consumer profiles. The findings can inform more targeted promotions and user-experience design. The study is limited to 198 respondents from Palembang, so the findings may not represent e-commerce users in other regions.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】准确的客户细分有助于实现更加个性化的电子商务营销。然而，基于交易频率、最近交易时间和交易金额（RFM）的模型主要关注交易历史，可能无法全面反映消费者的购物动机或他们在电子商务中的消费占比（即“钱包份额”/Share of Wallet, SoW）。本研究旨在利用K-Prototypes算法，根据交易数据和消费者行为对电子商务用户进行分类。数据来源于印度尼西亚巨港市的198名电子商务用户。分类变量包括RFM、SoW、购物动机以及产品类别偏好；年龄类别则用于后续分析。通过Elbow方法和Silhouette Score评估，最终确定了四个用户群体：高价值促销追逐者（High-Value Promo Hunters）、常规实用型购物者（Routine Pragmatic Shoppers）、被动小额消费者（Passive Micro-Spenders）以及紧急大额消费者（Urgent Big-Ticket Buyers）。卡方检验（Chi-square test）显示年龄类别与用户群体之间存在显著关联（Cramér’s V值为0.274），这表明年龄因素会影响消费者的购物行为，但并不能...。

papers.title: Rough log-normal stochastic volatility with quadratic drift: second-moment stability and the martingale property under positive correlation
papers.abstract: We extend the log-normal stochastic volatility model with quadratic drift to a fractional Volterra equation. The volatility has a unique global non-negative solution with finite moments on every finite horizon. With linear drift we derive the conditional first and second moments, expected integrated variance and conditional squared VIX. We give the exact threshold for a uniformly bounded second moment and the exponential growth rate above it. With positive quadratic damping the second moment is uniformly bounded for every admissible Hurst exponent and volatility of volatility. A separate bound on long-run expected integrated variance per unit time depends only on the drift parameters. Under the share measure the volatility beta offsets the quadratic damping. The price is a true martingale when damping covers beta. For a positive finite exponential mixture this condition is also necessary. The converse for a singular fractional kernel remains open. We illustrate calibration under positive correlation on observed Bitcoin and Ether option smiles and benchmark the simulation against exact moments. A marked order-flow construction relates multiplicative volatility noise to signed trade impacts arriving at a rate proportional to variance. A small state-dependent bias generates the quadratic drift. We establish a stopped diffusion limit for the constant kernel.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们将具有二次漂移的对数正态随机波动率模型扩展为分数阶Volterra方程。该模型下的波动率具有唯一的全局非负解，并且在每个有限时间范围内都满足有限的矩性质。在考虑线性漂移的情况下，我们推导出了条件一阶和二阶矩、预期积分方差以及条件平方VIX（Volatility Index）的值。我们确定了条件二阶矩为均匀有界的精确阈值，以及该阈值以上的指数增长率。当存在正的二次阻尼时，对于所有可行的Hurst指数和波动率水平，条件二阶矩均保持均匀有界。长期预期积分方差（单位时间内的方差）的上限仅与漂移参数有关。在股票测度下，当阻尼效应能够抵消波动率的β效应时，价格过程构成一个真正的鞅；对于具有正的有限指数混合分布的情况，这一条件也是必需的。而对于具有奇异分数核函数的情况，其逆命题目前尚未得到证明。我们通过观察比特币和以太坊期权价格微笑曲线（option smiles）在正相关条件下的拟合结果来验证模型的有效性，并将模拟结果与理论矩值进行对比。我们提出了一种基于订单流的构造方法，将乘性波动率噪声与以方差为比例的成交影响联系起来；同时，一个小的状态依赖性偏差被用来生成二次漂移效应。最后，我们为具...。研究方法：数值模拟、模型校准、随机过程。

papers.title: Delta-Vega Hedging with Deep Reinforcement Learning: From Simulation to Reality
papers.abstract: Hedging an option portfolio with the underlying asset alone leaves the position exposed to changes in volatility, which can be managed by trading another derivative, at higher transaction costs. We propose a deep reinforcement learning approach to hedge both price and volatility risk under discrete-time trading and transaction costs, by trading the underlying asset and a second, longer-dated option. We train the agent with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) on synthetic data from a stochastic volatility model, and restrict its state to quantities observable in the market, so that the policy learned in simulation applies directly to market data. In simulation, we validate the policy against semi-analytical Delta and Delta-Vega hedging benchmarks. PPO matches Delta-Vega's objective at baseline transaction costs and increasingly outperforms it as costs rise, with both two-instrument strategies consistently outperforming the single-instrument Delta hedge. On historical S&P 500 index option data, we benchmark our approach against practitioner Black-Scholes Delta and Delta-Vega hedging strategies. The two-instrument strategies roughly halve the profit-and-loss dispersion of the Delta hedge, and PPO attains a lower profit-and-loss volatility than Delta-Vega at comparable transaction costs. PPO holds more of the hedging option than Delta-Vega, in line with the stochastic-volatility model hedge, and its advantage is concentrated in high-volatility episodes.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】仅使用标的资产来对冲期权组合会使得投资组合暴露于波动率变化的风险中，这种风险可以通过交易另一种衍生品来管理，但这样做会带来更高的交易成本。我们提出了一种基于深度强化学习的方法，在离散时间交易和存在交易成本的情况下，同时对冲价格风险和波动率风险。该方法通过交易标的资产以及一个到期时间更长的期权来实现。我们使用近端策略优化（Proximal Policy Optimization, PPO）算法，在基于随机波动率模型的合成数据上对智能体进行训练，并将其状态限制为市场中可观测的量，以确保在模拟中学习到的策略可以直接应用于实际市场数据。在模拟中，我们通过半解析的Delta对冲和Delta-Vega对冲基准来验证该策略的有效性。在基准交易成本下，PPO策略能够达到与Delta-Vega策略相同的目标；随着交易成本的增加，PPO策略的表现逐渐优于Delta-Vega策略，且这两种多工具策略始终优于单一工具的Delta对冲策略。在历史上的标准普尔500指数期权数据上，我们将我们的方法与实际应用的Black-Scholes Delta对冲和Delta-Vega对冲策略进行了对比。多工具策略将De...。研究方法：数值模拟、随机过程、优化方法。

papers.title: Large-Scale Streaming Portfolio Optimization with Pauli Correlation Encoding
papers.abstract: Classical portfolio construction over large asset universes is a combinatorial selection problem that existing heuristics do not solve well at scale. Pauli Correlation Encoding (PCE) addresses this by representing the underlying clustering problem with far fewer qubits than one per asset, and a prior study showed it is competitive with classical methods on a single historical snapshot. This paper moves beyond that static test to a streaming deployment, in which the correlation structure and the portfolio are both re-estimated on a rolling basis, as a live rebalancing system would actually operate. We introduce two streaming variants -- PCE itself and a joint multi-cut variant, dPCE -- and evaluate both against a Buy & Hold baseline across window lengths, portfolio sizes up to several thousand assets, risk-aversion and transaction-cost settings, and measurement-shot budgets. Streaming PCE and dPCE consistently outperform the passive baseline, including during a market downturn where both lose money but PCE loses markedly less -- evidence that the method's value is not confined to rising markets. PCE also proves the more practical choice at scale, since dPCE's resource requirements and its sensitivity to rebalancing frequency both grow faster with portfolio size. We further report which operational choices -- rebalancing cadence, shot budget, and transaction-cost awareness -- matter most for a real deployment, and which matter less than commonly assumed.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在大型资产组合中构建经典投资组合是一个组合选择问题，现有的启发式方法在处理大规模数据时表现不佳。Pauli相关性编码（PCE）通过使用远少于每个资产一个量子比特的方式来表示潜在的聚类问题，先前的研究已经证明其在单一历史数据点上的表现与经典方法相当。本文将研究范围扩展到动态环境，即相关结构和投资组合都根据实时数据不断重新估计，这符合实际投资组合再平衡系统的运作方式。我们提出了两种动态实现方式：PCE本身以及一种联合多切割变体dPCE，并在多种条件下对它们进行了评估，包括不同的持有策略、投资组合规模（最多可达数千个资产）、风险厌恶程度、交易成本以及数据采集预算。结果表明，PCE和dPCE在各种情况下均显著优于被动持有策略，即使在市场下跌期间也是如此——尽管两者都会亏损，但PCE的亏损幅度更小，这表明该方法的价值不仅限于市场上涨时期。此外，从实际应用的角度来看，PCE更具可行性，因为dPCE的资源需求和对再平衡频率的敏感性会随着投资组合规模的扩大而迅速增加。我们还分析了哪些操作决策（如再平衡频率、数据采集预算和交易成本考量）对实际投资组合管理至关重要，哪些则不如人们普遍认为的那么重要。。

papers.title: What it is to Obey
papers.abstract: Prior to agents taking part in a simultaneous-move game, a designer commits a device that sends signals to each of the agents, evaluating the resulting set of equilibria according to a (Hausdorff-)continuous function. In games of incomplete information I show that it must be without loss of optimality for the designer to restrict attention to direct obedient devices if and only if she assumes her preferred equilibrium will be played. In games of complete information, I characterize the monotone evaluations, which include both the maximally optimistic one and the maximally pessimistic one.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在代理人参与同时行动的博弈之前，设计者会设置一种机制，该机制向每个代理人发送信号，并根据一个（豪斯多夫）连续函数来评估由此产生的均衡集合。在不完全信息博弈中，我证明了：只有当设计者认为自己偏好的均衡会被实现时，她才可以在不损失最优性的前提下，仅关注那些能够“直接服从”其指令的机制。在完全信息博弈中，我描述了这些评估函数的性质，这些函数既包括最乐观的评估结果，也包括最悲观的评估结果。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Semivariance and Semivolatility in Portfolio Selection: A Unified Framework for Downside-Risk Portfolio Models
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study downside risk in portfolio selection beyond minimum-risk models, where semivariance and its square root, semivolatility, yield the same portfolio. Downside-risk models are often presented as direct extensions of their variance-based counterparts, although different classes of portfolio problems require different properties of the risk measure. We classify these models by the degree of positive homogeneity of the risk measure in the weights: degree one makes risk contributions add up to the portfolio risk and keeps diversification and reward-to-risk ratios scale invariant. For three thresholds, the portfolio mean, zero and a market-index return, we state a non-degeneracy condition on long-only downside risk under which the risk-parity, most-diversified and Sortino-ratio problems are well posed. Under this condition, the two ratio problems reduce to convex programs, and the differentiability of semivolatility ensures that the risk-budgeting formulation attains the prescribed budgets. We also characterize when below-mean semivolatility is additive. Finally, we provide an out-of-sample analysis on two real-world datasets of total returns, the current constituents of the Dow Jones and Nasdaq-100 indexes. We compare seventeen long-only strategies, covering the minimum-risk, reward-to-risk, risk-parity and most-diversified families, in a rolling-window backtest, and test the differences within each family by block-bootstrap inference.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本文研究了在超越最小风险模型的投资组合选择中的下行风险问题。在这些模型中，半方差及其平方根（即半波动率）能够产生相同的投资组合效果。下行风险模型通常被视为基于方差的风险模型的直接扩展，然而不同类型的投资组合问题需要风险度量具有不同的属性。我们根据风险度量在权重中的正齐次性程度对这些模型进行分类：当齐次性为一时，风险贡献会累加到投资组合总风险中，并且分散化效果以及收益与风险比率保持不变。针对三个阈值（即投资组合均值、零以及市场指数收益率），我们提出了一个非退化条件，以确保在仅持有长期资产的情况下下行风险模型的合理性；在该条件下，风险平价、最大分散化以及Sortino比率问题能够得到有效解决。此时，这两个比率问题可转化为凸优化问题，而半波动率的可微性保证了风险预算模型的设定能够准确实现预定的预算目标。我们还探讨了在何种情况下低于均值的半波动率具有可加性。最后，我们利用道琼斯指数和纳斯达克100指数实际总收益的两个真实世界数据集进行了样本外分析，通过滚动窗口回测比较了十七种仅持有长期资产的策略（涵盖最小风险、收益与风险比率、风险平价以及最大分散化三类策略），并利用块自助法（block-...。
